approved_scope: Read-only Go parser for existing Grype JSON presenter output. Typed vulnerability/package matches and reported scanner, database and NVD metadata; missing CVE feed remains unknown. No scanner execution, API/UI or persistence.
source_identity_method: SHA-256 of sorted relative-path + NUL + per-file SHA-256 hex + newline UTF-8 records.
source_identity_scope: 437 tracked/nonignored current source, tests, configs, locks and documentation files; excludes docs/evidence, plans/progress.json, plans/requirements.json, plans/project-state.json, docs/agents/SESSION_HANDOFF.json, apps/web/src/generated/project.json and SHA256SUMS.txt. Ignored dependency/build/cache outputs are excluded by git.
